entries.reason: reviewed and accepted: skill-rewrite is deliberately not a self-contained bundle. Its own SKILL.md says so in the shipped release — 'This skill is not self-contained ... A pruner who removes the guard as an unused file, or who installs this skill alone, gets no draft at all. Install or prune the two skills together.' — and README.md, RELEASE_NOTES.md and CHANGELOG.md each repeat it. The four plugin manifests declare ./skills/ as the installed unit, under which this reference resolves inside. The finding is true of the sub-unit the gate was pointed at, and the rule is right to report it to anyone who installs this directory alone.

reviewed and accepted: the same accepted dependency as the entry above, named a second time by the shellcheck directive that tells the linter where the sourced guard lives. Accepted for the same reason and on the same terms — if either line changes, both fingerprints miss and the blocker returns.
